verdict.rationale: Convertio documents a general converter covering more than 300 formats and lists a dedicated Ebook Converter, so e-book conversion is part of its own capability. None of the named formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) or their pairwise conversions appear explicitly in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit format list confirming Markdown, LaTeX, HTML, EPUB and DOCX support, documented conversion pairs between them, API docs for document/markup conversion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other

citations.quote: We support more than 25600 different conversions between more than 300 different file formats.
